ercot256_extension.basis: Rule 17 [R-FLOOR-WINDOW] and rule 1 [R-STRUCT], not a residual. The incumbent's own D-4 per-unit conduct rows convict st_netload_drag on plants whose meters read a median of 0.000 MW over the hours the floor forces them: Lake Hubbard (3452) and R W Miller (3628) in 2021, Handley (3491) in 2024 and 2025, Cedar Bayou (3460) in 2025. Lake Hubbard generated exactly ZERO in Jan/Feb/Mar 2021 and ran 1,924 of 8,760 h. The model's OWN merit-order guard had already measured the absence (272.8 unit-days of Lake Hubbard unit 1 reclassified as ECONOMIC LAY-UP), so the drag floor contradicted its own pipeline. The mask subtracts that measured share from the floor's clip basis and touches availability not at all. ZERO free parameters; BACKCAST ONLY at two layers.
ercot256_extension.effect: C8 ST_GAS improves in EVERY year: 37.6->33.1 % (2021), 26.0->22.6 (2022), 17.4->13.4 (2023), 15.3->12.7 (2024), 20.1->16.6 (2025). Two of five D-4 conduct convictions CLEAR (3628 in 2021, 3460 in 2025). C3a/C3b improve in 2023 and 2025, are flat in 2024, and move <=0.2 pp / 0.001 on the held-out rungs. C3c is BIT-IDENTICAL in all five years (230/101/180/22/1 h). C1 and C2 all PASS in every year. Slack and dump 0.0000.
